open_blockers.detail: Owner has NO ADMIN RIGHTS. Xcode 26.3 + iOS SDK 26.2 present, but /Library/Developer/PrivateFrameworks/{CoreDevice,CoreSimulator}.framework are absent and only an admin can install them. xcodebuild refuses to start without CoreSimulator even for a device-only unsigned build, so NO iOS build of any kind is possible. The paid Developer Program does NOT work around this — TestFlight still needs an .ipa, which needs xcodebuild. FIX: an admin runs `sudo xcodebuild -runFirstLaunch` once; after that a FREE Apple ID / Personal Team suffices. Verified working without admin: Godot generates the full iOS Xcode project, device+sim xcframeworks, MoltenVK and PCK; stops only on missing app icons.
open_blockers.owner: user — needs someone with admin on this Mac

open_blockers.detail: Android SDK and JDK not installed, but both install entirely under $HOME with no admin. Do NOT use Homebrew --cask (writes to root-owned /usr/local). Full user-local commands in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md. This is the only route to the Phase 0 gate that is not admin-blocked.
